name: workspace-profile-section
title: Workspace profile section
description: A workspace's name, URL, default time zone and language, with a live preview of the address, a warning before links change and a save that lights up.

files.content:

  label: string;
}

docs: The slug is limited to lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens as you type. onCheckSlug resolves true when an address is free; it is asked after a pause in typing and only for an address that differs from the saved one. Changing the slug shows a warning in words before saving. timeZones takes IANA names, listed in the order you pass them, and languages takes { value, label } pairs; both lists are searchable (a language is also found by its name in `locale`, so "German" finds Deutsch) and have sensible defaults in defaults.ts. While Save runs the fields are locked. Pass the saved workspace back as `workspace` after onSave and the form follows. title, description and headingLevel (2 or 3) rename the heading and set its level.
